meta.scope_note: Host-independent deterministic callset, VCFv4.2/v4.3 strict schema-validator, bcftools norm --check-ref e FASTA concordance, and diploid rtg vcfeval metrics (zero host-dependent wall-clock/RSS timings).

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Applies bijective VCFv4.2 percent-encoding on `INFO/SAMPLE` (`%2D`, `%2E`, `%XX`)
switch_catalog.name: sanitize_sample_info
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Interpolates raw `;`, `=`, `,`, `%`, `-`, `.`, and whitespace into `INFO/SAMPLE`, splitting VCFv4.2 fields

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Emits standard `<DUP>` symbolic `ALT` with non-negative span and unified `2 * SVFLANK + dup_val` genotype
switch_catalog.name: standard_dup_symbolic_alt
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Emits non-standard `<dup-N>` symbolic `ALT` when `mlen < 100` and mismatches homozygous `<DUP>` span

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Re-extracts FASTA-concordant 3-prime-shifted deletion and insertion `REF`/`ALT` alleles with CRISPR double-shift guard
switch_catalog.name: shift3_3prime_alleles
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Shifts `-3` indel coordinates 3-prime without updating `REF` and `ALT` sequences to match the reference FASTA

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Enforces merged requested interval bounds (`start_pos >= 1` within target intervals)
switch_catalog.name: strict_region_bounds
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Allows realigned indel and SV anchors to spill outside requested `-R` or BED target intervals

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Suppresses `-p` `<R,R>` and `N/N` zero-depth sentinel rows in Simple and Amplicon modes
switch_catalog.name: suppress_pileup_sentinels
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Emits spurious position-0 `<R,R>` and `N/N` zero-depth sentinel records in `-p` pileup mode

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Computes `INFO/DUPRATE` from live `u64` duplicate and total read counters across untiled and tiled runs
switch_catalog.name: live_duprate
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Copies zeroed read counters before pileup iteration, leaving `INFO/DUPRATE` permanently `0`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Preserves both unprefixed and `chr`-prefixed sex and mitochondrial contigs under total contig order
switch_catalog.name: preserve_mixed_sex_contigs
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Drops `chrX`, `chrY`, or `chrM` in `var2vcf` `reorder` when unprefixed `X`, `Y`, or `MT` co-occur

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Absorbs negative trailing `M` into `rdoff_corr` during homopolymer multi-indel CIGAR coalescing
switch_catalog.name: cigar_homopolymer_merge
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Produces negative trailing `M` (`rm < 0`) during homopolymer multi-indel merges in `modifyCigar`, skipping the read

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Treats `=` (`SequenceMatch`) and `X` (`SequenceMismatch`) equivalently to `M` across pileup, realignment, and dedup
switch_catalog.name: eqx_cigar_read_length
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Excludes `=` and `X` CIGAR operators from aligned read length, yielding `rlen1 = 0` and negative `PMEAN`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Retains single-sample symbolic SVs supported by discordant mate pairs (`SPANPAIR > 0`) unless `--min-splitreads` is set
switch_catalog.name: preserve_discordant_svs
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Drops single-sample symbolic `<DEL>`, `<DUP>`, and `<INV>` calls whenever `SPLITREAD < 1` despite `SPANPAIR > 0`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Passes pre-decrement inclusive cluster end `mark_pe` when `tbp != 0` and `tbp < pe`
switch_catalog.name: mark_dup_sv_inclusive_end
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Passes post-decrement `pe` to `markDUPSV`, truncating the `svfdup` mate-cluster right boundary by 1 bp

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Gates `find_inv_sub_paths` mate-window loads on local `>= 12 bp` soft-clip presence and validated `find_match_rev`
switch_catalog.name: sv_lazy_mate_pileup
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Scans mate windows eagerly in `findINVsub` before checking local `>= 12 bp` soft-clip presence or reverse-complement match

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Rounds exact IEEE-754 binary `f64` values via `round_half_even_compat` without `DigitList` underflow truncation
switch_catalog.name: exact_binary_half_even
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Truncates `5e-(d+1)` underflow ties to `0.0` in OpenJDK `DecimalFormat` `DigitList` despite binary `f64` exceeding midpoint

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Enforces `VD <= DP`, `AF <= 1.0`, `ADJAF <= 1.0`, and `HICNT <= HICOV` (`HIAF <= 1.0`) across all variant types
switch_catalog.name: reconcile_vd_dp
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Increments realigned `VD` and `HICNT` without updating locus `DP` and `HICOV`, permitting `VD > DP` and `AF > 1.0`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Iterates variant and post-processing position maps in strictly ascending genomic coordinate order
switch_catalog.name: coordinate_sorted_vars
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Iterates variant and post-processing position maps in `JavaHashMap` bucket order rather than coordinate order

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Omits out-of-bounds sentinel mismatch and length increment when `rem5 < rem3` in `find_35_match`
switch_catalog.name: exact_35_overlap
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Adds `+1` spurious out-of-bounds loop sentinel mismatch and `+1` overlap length when `rem5 < rem3` in `find35match`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Matches exact deletion CIGAR operator length (`len == dlen`) in `no_passing_reads`
switch_catalog.name: exact_cigar_dlen_match
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Uses substring `contains(dlen + "D")` in `noPassingReads`, falsely matching decimal suffixes such as `12D` for `2D`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Continues (`continue`) evaluating remaining tumor candidate alleles at multi-allelic somatic loci
switch_catalog.name: somatic_continue_after_bad_var
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Executes `break` in `printVariationsFromFirstSample` when the top-AF candidate fails `isGoodVar`, dropping passing secondary alleles

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Threads directional `5`/`3` soft-clip orientation and `--adaptor` screening across all 20 consensus call sites
switch_catalog.name: adaptor_all_consensus_dirs
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Calls `findConseq(sc, 0)` without `--adaptor` sets in `adjustMNP`, `realignIndels`, `sv`, and `adjSNV`, assembling adapter chimeras

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Emits canonical 1-bp upstream VCFv4.2 anchor, `##ALT` headers, negative `<DEL>` `SVLEN` (`END - POS == abs(SVLEN)`), and paired `END;SVTYPE;SVLEN`
switch_catalog.name: canonical_sv_vcf_anchoring
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Emits multi-kb `REF` spans on symbolic SVs, positive `SVLEN` on `<DEL>`, missing `##ALT` headers, and missing paired SV `INFO` tags

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Runs per-amplicon tumor-normal pileup, primer masking, and `GDAMP;TLAMP;NCAMP;AMPFLAG` `AMPBIAS` concordance across `.var` and VCF
switch_catalog.name: paired_somatic_amplicon
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Runs single-sample `AmpliconMode` on `bam1` only in `.var` mode and rejects paired `-b` plus `-a` in VCF mode

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Strips outer positive-length `H`/`P` operators without advancing `alignment_start` and treats interior `P` as non-consuming
switch_catalog.name: cigar_strip_outer_hard_clips
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Leaves outer `H`/`P` operators blocking terminal `I -> S` and `D` stripping in `CigarModifier` and distorting `PMEAN`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Floors subtracted `PMEAN`, `QMEAN`, `MQ`, `NM`, and VCF `QUAL` at `0.0` (`>= 0.0`)
switch_catalog.name: nonnegative_subtracted_means
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Subtracts `qmean` and `pmean` in `Variation.subCnt` without flooring at zero, allowing negative `PMEAN`, `QMEAN`, and VCF `QUAL`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Resets all auxiliary `Variation` accumulators on `cnt = 0` and reconciles `fwd + rev == VD` and `0 <= HICNT <= VD`
switch_catalog.name: reconcile_strand_and_hq_sums
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Zeros `cnt = 0` without clearing `fwd`, `rev`, or `hicnt`, leaving `ALD[0] + ALD[1] != VD` and `HICNT > VD`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Enforces `DP >= RD + VD` (`total_pos_cov >= ref_fwd + ref_rev + pos_coverage`) across variant and somatic builders
switch_catalog.name: reconcile_rd_vd_dp
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Adjusts `ref_coverage` independently of `ref_fwd + ref_rev`, allowing `RD + VD > DP` (`AD[0] + AD[1] > DP`)

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Reduces IUPAC ambiguity codes in `ALT` outside symbolic `<...>` brackets and suppresses non-pileup `REF == ALT` records
switch_catalog.name: sanitize_iupac_alt_alleles
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Reduces IUPAC ambiguity codes only on `REF`, leaking IUPAC codes into `ALT` and emitting non-pileup `REF == ALT` records

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Materializes explicit sequence alleles (`<= 32,768 bp`) for split-refined SVs shorter than `-L` and suppresses short discordant-only SVs
switch_catalog.name: sv_respect_min_len
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Ignores `-L` (`--min-sv-len`) in `find_del`, `find_dup`, and `find_inv`, emitting sub-1000 bp SVs as symbolic `<DUP>`/`<INV>`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Hydrates and emits the `ALT="."` reference pileup row whenever all candidate variants shift away from a `-p` locus
switch_catalog.name: pileup_preserve_shifted_ref
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Checks `vvar.size() == 1` during `-p` hydration, silently dropping covered coordinates when `>= 2` indels shift away

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Recomputes `Variant::var_type` after `adj_complex` across Simple, Amplicon, and Somatic post-processing
switch_catalog.name: recompute_vartype_after_adj_complex
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Computes `INFO/TYPE` before `adjComplex` trims shared bases, leaving trimmed SNVs and indels mislabeled `TYPE=Complex`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Emits strict `Number=R` `FORMAT/AD` cardinality (`1 + n_alt`: `AD=rd` when `ALT="."` and `AD=rd,vd` when `ALT != "."`)
switch_catalog.name: strict_vcf_ad_number_r
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Keys single-sample `FORMAT/AD` on `VD != 0`, emitting 2-element `AD=rd,0` on `ALT="."` rows and 1-element `AD=rd` on `VD=0` variants

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Omits `INFO/END` on non-symbolic VCF records by default while retaining `INFO/END` on symbolic `<...>` SVs unless `--no-end` is set
switch_catalog.name: omit_nonsv_vcf_end
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Emits `INFO/END` on every SNV and short indel under `-R` when `--no-end` is omitted, failing `GATK ValidateVariants` and `bcftools norm`

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Canonicalizes unphased `1/0` to `0/1` and promotes concrete non-dot `0/0` `ALT` carriers (`VD > 0`) to `0/1`
switch_catalog.name: canonical_vcf_gt
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Emits unphased `1/0` (`0.5 <= AF < 1 - GTFREQ`) and `0/0` on sub-threshold `VD > 0` carriers (ignored as `CALL=IGN` in diploid `rtg vcfeval`)

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Emits all passing `(CHROM, POS, END, REF, ALT)` alleles per locus sorted by 4-decimal `AF` descending (`--all-alleles`, `--vcfall`)
switch_catalog.name: --vcf-all-alleles
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Collapses multi-allelic loci to a single highest-AF winner per position unless Perl `var2vcf_*.pl -A` is piped externally

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Enforces `-a` primer-edge distance strictly on primed amplicon edge(s) (`-sp`) and bypasses sheared-end overlap filtering
switch_catalog.name: --amplicon-single-primer
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Enforces two-primer 5-prime and 3-prime edge distance plus `0.95` overlap filters on sheared R2 ends, discarding QIAseq/Archer SPE reads

switch_catalog.compat_off_behavior: Configures `--compat=off`, standard 0-based BED indexing, and modality-calibrated filters for `wgs`, `wes`, `amplicon`, and `ctdna`
switch_catalog.name: --preset
switch_catalog.vardictjava_behavior: Requires manual 1-based vs 0-based BED `-c/-S/-E/-z` flags and separate Perl `var2vcf` filter pipes across sequencing modalities
